content:
Renames a folder for the current user. You cannot rename Tenable-provided scan folders or custom
folders that belong to other users (even if your account has administrator privileges).
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.TOGGLE_WAS.USE  custom role privilege. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: d30881ae-6b5c-4b1e-ad60-f2643d0da492
The UUID of the folder.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The name of the folder.
Note: Folder names can only contain letters, numbers, underscores,
hyphens, and whitespace.
